[ipa-delivery:832] Build the private RewindBox IPA 832: the 831 with DeSmuME's direct 3D capture by lines, 2D composition through NEON and live core timings, nothing else

As the maintainer asked for the 831: this session's corrections only, nothing from the other sessions on
top, over the last IPA (831: 40 fps at most in Animal Crossing, and a session log without core timings).

- Base: the verified 831 (7b933e36, run 45363528917, attempt 1).
- libretro: the collection LibretroCores-f5857282 (run 45379028317, artifact 14913662229) replaces
  LibretroCores-6f969042; only desmume_libretro changes (a direct capture of the 3D waits for its own
  lines; the 2D engines' SSE2 paths through NEON; rasterizer threads one QoS class below the emulation
  thread; [rb-perf] r3d/bands/bwait/cap/cap3d/ecpu/rcpu/t3d). Pictures bit-identical to the 831 core off
  device (75 cases on x86, 39 on AArch64 with the JIT).
- libretro bridge: the core's [rb-perf] and [rb-jit] lines reach session.log as they come.
- Deferred: the S2Arm engine patches 0342-0344 and the MeloNX bridge stall records (other sessions).
- RPCS3, MeloNX, Xenia and S2Arm unchanged from the base; Dolphin, ARMSX2, the MeloNX dependencies, the
  App and every other bridge are those of the 831.
- Must change: desmume_libretro, libretro_internal_bridge and Runner. Tests not run (AGENTS.md); the
  delivery contract passed locally (120 tests, 4 skipped) and with the API checks.

Nothing measured on an iPhone.
